fieldNotes.truckGate: Dedicated private entrance road (Costco Dr) off N Division St; multi-lane truck approach with directional lane arrows and semis queued in z20/z21 imagery; full chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in 2025 Street View along the Division St frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Gate-island booth visible in the median between inbound/outbound truck lanes on Costco Dr (z20 gatecheck frame), with a security/admin building set beside the gate. Costco corporate standard; overnight truck parking is gated.
fieldNotes.guardShack_confidence: Booth island read from overhead at z20; Street View does not enter the private road so the booth is not seen at ground level, but the median structure + lane split is unambiguous.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron (4+ paved truck lanes through the gate throat) with room to dedicate an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide multi-lane paved staging area on Costco Dr just inside the entrance where semis stack before proceeding to docks (z20 imagery shows several trucks lined up).
fieldNotes.dropYard: 482 marked trailer-parking stalls per facility records; satellite shows multiple long rows of parked trailers/containers (white + colored intermodal-style boxes) in dedicated drop yards north and central of the building.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Facility records: 100 overhead doors with 53 precast loading positions; dock doors with trailers backed in visible on multiple building faces. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 1.1M-sqft cross-dock building plus a detached front security/admin building and a truck-service/canopy structure near the gate; counted as 2 primary structures (a separate neighboring DC to the west is NOT part of this property).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; nearest rail is not connected to the yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the north side of Morris IL, adjacent to farm fields on the north and west; classified Rural per rubric (small-town/edge-of-town setting).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh platform positively identified in the truck path; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock with docks on multiple faces but no clearly separate ship vs. receive bank confirmed from overhead; left false/uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~195 acres computed via shoelace on the traced fence-line perimeter (includes detention ponds and a southwest expansion/grading pad).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count from the captured z16-z18 imagery across the drop yards and dock aprons.
